title: A producer edits a shop that already exists

criteria.text: Owner edits image, name, about and a free-text values line from one prefilled page
criteria.note: [V] image, name, about: Edit page Basics card (EditCards.tsx, #472) through group.update (#158). Values half: no values field and no column; the 'Values & badges' card is a placeholder. Conflict: values cut by the scenario's own approved line ('values statement cut') and the 2026-09-07 ruling, yet the criterion text still names the values line. Routed to scope-scenario

criteria.text: Only an active owner can save; the write goes through a named handler with an event row
criteria.note: [V] group.update (src/actions/group/update.ts): managing role with left_at null, active/archived only, appends group.updated naming the fields. Built in #158 (no Reviewed by line); deploy-health green on 1ebe680. Smoked: unknown, the edit page has no stable live address in smoke-live. unmarked: src/actions/group/update.test.ts ('refuses a stranger', 'writes an event naming the fields that changed')

criteria.text: The values column has no source or provenance field; nothing but the owner's own edit can write it
criteria.note: [V] no values_statement column in supabase/migrations or src; tests/migrations-page-identity.test.ts asserts only that one migration does not add it. Same conflict as 1: the values line is cut, so the column this guards does not exist. Routed to scope-scenario

criteria.text: A tagline of at most 120 characters, separate from the description, on card, profile and link preview
criteria.note: [V] no tagline column in supabase/migrations, no field in group.update or Edit, nothing in share-metadata. TileCard takes a tagline prop but OwnPages passes the description into it. Ticket #584

criteria.text: A Page with every optional field empty renders correctly, with nothing nagging
criteria.note: [V] ShopPublicPage omits an empty description, placement heading and badge (sections built in #472, Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 614c920) [A: not nagging, nothing asserts the whole Page]. Smoked: unknown, smoke-live opens the first Page Explore lists, not one with every field empty. unmarked: ShopPublicPage.test.tsx ('omits it when empty', 'no empty heading, no placeholder'). Check ticket #845

criteria.text: On the draft or live Page, an address search resolves to real coordinates with a confirming pin before saving; an unresolvable address refuses loudly
criteria.note: [V] WhereFields + PinAdjustMap (#351, Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 3492589); 'Drop a pin' (#441, Reviewed by) saves the map's coordinates, not a placeholder. With no map key the address is used as found and no map is drawn. Smoked: unknown, page-edit is not in smoke-live's stable addresses. unmarked: WhereFields.test.tsx ('says so when nothing matches the address'), PinAdjustMap.test.tsx, LocationPlaceFields.test.tsx

criteria.text: A neighbourhood or town from a seeded list covering MSA 40900; a neighbourhood-mode Page shows no street address anywhere and a pin at the area centre
criteria.note: [V] seeded boundaries (#350: 88 places, 165 neighbourhoods; no Reviewed by line), pick in #351 and #468 (Reviewed by), saves a neighborhoodId and no point (where-save.ts). Page map draws a pin at the area centre (PageMap.tsx). Invariant: no standing guard over every surface that reads a Page's location. Smoked: unknown. unmarked: where-save.test.ts, tests/boundaries-db.test.ts

criteria.text: Owner picks or creates tags in their own words, editable any time; no category and no 'Something else'; at least one tag to publish
criteria.note: [V] group.update replaces the tag set (#288, no Reviewed by; deploy-health green on a5ab3a1); group.activate refuses a Page with no tags. group.update still accepts a category but no Edit or Create component offers one. Smoked: unknown. unmarked: update.test.ts ('refuses to leave a Page with no tags'), activate.test.ts, ShopPublicPage.test.tsx ('shows no category chip')

criteria.text: Optional public business phone, separate from the private phone; members only by default, the owner may open it to everyone
criteria.note: [V] groups.contact_phone granted to authenticated only; loadPageView reads contact only when signed in (#305, no Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 7381f60). Text follows the 2026-10-07 ruling, which replaced 'signed-in visitors only' with a per-field everyone/members setting, phone defaulting to members: the default is built, the per-field switch is not (#480, open). Smoked: unknown. unmarked: tests/page-contact-db.test.ts ('never answer a signed-out caller')
